h1: Lead tracking: know where each lead came from
overview: When a lead arrives, you should know whether it came from search, an ad, social media, a referral or a link in an email. We set up tracking so each form submission carries its source with it. That means link tags, hidden form fields, analytics goals and a clean place to see it all, such as your CRM or a sheet. We test every route with real clicks, so the numbers can be trusted.

faq: We can track clicks on phone numbers on your site. Tracking calls themselves needs a call tracking service, and we advise on one and connect it on Premium.
What if a lead comes in with no clear source?
Some leads arrive direct, with no trail, for example when they type your address in. We label those as direct or unknown rather than guessing, so the numbers stay honest.
Is source tracking allowed under privacy laws?
We use standard analytics and link tags that follow consent settings. Your site needs a cookie notice where your region requires one, and we check yours is working with the tags.
Which tools do you work with?
Google Analytics, Tag Manager, HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive, Google Sheets and common form tools. Tell us what you use, and we confirm before we begin.
